title: automate-kms-hsm-tls-rotation-private-installer-vault-sealed-secrets
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Automates TLS certificate rotation for Private Installer with KMS/HSM support and Vault/SealedSecrets integrations. Adds a secret-rotator controller, Helm chart hooks, Terraform KMS module updates, and upgrade/rollback safety checks.
description: Motivation: Private deployments need automated, auditable TLS and key rotation that works with customer-managed KMS/HSM and secrets backends (Vault and sealed-secrets). This PR implements an end-to-end automation flow: a secret-rotator controller in the installer, Helm chart updates to support in-place cert/key swap with pre/post hooks, Terraform module updates to provision/attach KMS keys and HSM roles, and helper scripts for safe key rewraps. The overall goal is to provide a safe, reversible rotation path for certs and encryption keys with observability and minimal downtime. Key changes: 1) Added 'secret-rotator' controller to private-installer operator that watches TLS Secrets and triggers rotation workflows including KMS rewrap (supports AWS KMS, GCP KMS, and HSM-backed wrapping via PKCS#11 with a Vault intermediary). 2) Helm chart changes: new templates for secret-rotator deployment, pre-upgrade and post-upgrade hooks for draining and reloading services, and values.yaml flags to opt-in/out of automatic rotation. 3) Terraform: updated terraform/modules/kms to create key aliases, grant HSM roles, and output rewrap policies; added examples for on-prem HSM provisioning with customer-supplied connectors. 4) Sealed-secrets/Vault integration: controller supports unsealing patterns against Vault and can write new sealed secrets via a short-lived rewrap token. 5) Operational tooling: bin/scripts/kms/rewrap.sh for offline key rewraps, an upgrade safety-check that verifies KV cache compatibility and operator readiness, and a rollback playbook for certificate restoration. 6) Tests: unit tests for controller logic, e2e scenario test that rotates a cert in a VPC private-installer cluster using a mock HSM, and CI job that runs helm lint and terraform plan. Migration notes and rollout: rotation is opt-in by default. Operators must enable 'rotation.enabled=true' in values.yaml; for existing clusters follow the documented two-step migration: enable dry-run to surface lifecycle events, validate rewrap results, then enable live rotation. A rollback path restores previous secrets from the vault snapshot and restarts services with pre-hook. Security considerations: the controller never persists plaintext private keys; key material is rewrapped via customer KMS or HSM and Vault audit logs are recommended. See private-installer/docs/rotation.md for full operator guide and private-installer/docs/upgrade-rollback.md for the rollback procedure. CI: initial CI run hit a lint failure in helm templates which was fixed in a follow-up commit; final CI status is passing. Related Linear/Jira: ENG-2842 for controller design, SEC-137 for threat review, SUP-452 for customer incident that motivated the HSM support.

ci_summary: Initial run: helm lint failure (fixed). Terraform plan run showed no destructive changes for example configs. Final CI: all jobs passed including unit, e2e mock HSM rotation, helm-lint, terraform fmt/validate, and security scan.
testing_notes: Unit tests added for controller decision paths. E2E uses mock HSM fixture to simulate PKCS#11 operations and verifies zero downtime rotation with pre/post hooks. Manual smoke test performed against a customer-facing private-installer cluster using staging Vault and a wrapped KMS key. Dry-run mode validated secrets rewrap without committing changes.
upgrade_instructions: 1) Set rotation.enabled=false by default in values.yaml and enable rotation.dryRun=true to observe events. 2) Run helm upgrade with the new chart and monitor rotation.trace_id logs. 3) After validating dry-run success and CI tests, set rotation.dryRun=false and rotation.enabled=true to perform live rotations. 4) If issues occur, follow rollback playbook in private-installer/docs/upgrade-rollback.md which restores vault snapshot and reapplies previous helm release.
known_limitations: - On some legacy HSMs PKCS#11 sessions require special pin handling; see terraform/examples/hsm-onprem/README.md for workaround. - Vault audit integration requires Vault enterprise audit devices for full correlation. - Automatic rotation for customer-managed certificates (external CA) is not included; this PR focuses on infra-managed TLS for private-installer components.
notes_for_release: Operators should review rotation docs and test on staging clusters before enabling. Default is opt-in; recommend dry-run for 72 hours to observe events. Contact SRE for help with HSM connector tuning.
